title: Agent Patching goes Async and Video 'Pro Edit' arrives
summary: Vertex AI v1beta1 shifts Agent updates to Long Running Operations and introduces experimental 'Pro Edit' video capabilities. New observability features and Reasoning Engine garbage collection also debut.
details:
This update introduces a significant breaking change: the `projects.locations.agents.patch` method now returns a `GoogleLongrunningOperation` instead of the `Agent` resource directly. Developers must update their integration logic to poll the operation for completion. Additionally, the `data` field in the `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1beta1A2APart` schema has changed from `object` to `any`, which may impact strictly typed client implementations. 

On the feature side, experimental video generation now supports 'Pro Edit' via `CloudAiLargeModelsVisionGenerateVideoExperimentsProEditConfig`. This allows developers to modify existing video generations using text instructions or structured prompts by referencing a `fromOperationId`. For production monitoring, the `Agent` resource now includes an `observabilityConfig` to enable OpenTelemetry spans for tracking tool usage, model latencies, and token counts. Finally, Reasoning Engines now support a `revisionGarbageCollectionStrategy` to automatically manage resource bloat by keeping only the latest N runtime revisions.
